name: postgres-lab
description: Local PostgreSQL learning and query benchmark lab

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U lab -d commerce_lab
scripts.db:counts: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -X -U lab -d commerce_lab -f - < sql/counts.sql
scripts.db:size: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -X -U lab -d commerce_lab -c "SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size('commerce_lab')) AS database_size;"
scripts.db:table-sizes: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -X -U lab -d commerce_lab -c "SELECT relid::regclass AS table_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE schemaname = 'lab' ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC;"
